findings.message: `UNIX_SECONDS(datehour) >= 1748736000` wraps the partition column `datehour` in UNIX_SECONDS, so BigQuery can't use it to skip partitions of `proj.web.pageviews`. BigQuery rejects queries on this table unless a filter on `datehour` can limit the partitions.
findings.fix: Compare `datehour` itself with a constant, for example `datehour >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
